simple.meaning: דָּוָה (dâvâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to be sick (as if in menstruation).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Leviticus, beginning at Leviticus 12:2. The surrounding contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּוָה (H1738) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H1738. davah [ דָּוָה ] verb be ill, unwell (Late Hebrew ׳ד sorrowful, miserable , not in physical sense; compare Arabic [] be ill ; Ethiopic Assyrian perhaps derivatives di'û , illness Zim BP 96, 97 ; Aramaic דְּוָא דְּוִי, , , be sad ) — Qal Infinitive construct דְּוֺתָהּ נִדַּת כִּימֵי ֗֗֗ אִשָּׁה Lev 12:2 .
